H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
H1486: properly, a pebble, i.e. a lot (small stones being used for that purpose); figuratively, a portion or destiny (as if determined by lot)
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H3130: Joseph, the name of seven Israelites
H3383: Jarden, the principal river of Palestine
H3405: Jericho or Jerecho, a place in Palestine
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H4057: a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs)
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H3870: Luz, the name of two places in Palestine
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H1366: properly, a cord (as twisted), i.e. (by implication) a boundary; by extension the territory inclosed
H757: an Arkite or native of Erek
H5852: Ataroth, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine
H3381: to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications)
H3220: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
H3311: a Japhletite or descendant of Japhlet
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H1032: Beth-Choron, the name of two adjoining places in Palestine
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H8444: (only in plural collective) exit, i.e. (geographical) boundary, or (figuratively) deliverance, (actively) source
H5157: to inherit (as a (figurative) mode of descent), or (generally) to occupy; causatively, to bequeath, or (generally) distribute, instate
H4519: Menashsheh, a grandson of Jacob, also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
H669: Ephrajim, a son of Joseph; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
H4940: a family, i.e. circle of relatives; figuratively, a class (of persons), a species (of animals) or sort (of things); by extension a tribe or people
H5159: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion
H5945: an elevation, i.e. (adj.) lofty (compar.); as title, the Supreme
H6828: properly, hidden, i.e. dark; used only of the north as aquarter (gloomy and unknown)
H5437: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H3239: Janoach or Janochah, a place in Palestine
H5292: Naarah, the name of an Israelitess, and of a place in Palestine
H6293: to impinge, by accident or violence, or (figuratively) by importunity
H8599: Tappuach, the name of two places in Palestine, also of an Israelite
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H5158: a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine)
H7071: Kanah, the name of a stream and of a place in Palestine
H4294: a branch (as extending); figuratively, a tribe; also a rod, whether for chastising (figuratively, correction), ruling (a sceptre), throwing (a lance), or walking (a staff; figuratively, a support of life, e.g. bread)
H5892: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
H3995: a separation, i.e. (concretely) a separate place
H8432: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H2691: a yard (as inclosed by a fence); also a hamlet (as similarly surrounded with walls)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H3423: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication, to seize, to rob, to inherit; also to expel, to impoverish, to ruin
H3669: a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan; by implication, a pedlar (the Canaanites standing for their neighbors the Ishmaelites, who conducted mercantile caravans)
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H7130: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H4522: properly, a burden (as causing to faint), i.e. a tax in the form of forced labor
H5647: to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve, till, (causatively) enslave, etc.
